# yii3-health-check

## Install

```bash
composer require rasuvaeff/yii3-health-check
```

## Rules

- Three endpoints: `LivenessEndpoint` (`/live`), `ReadinessEndpoint` (`/ready`), `HealthEndpoint` (`/health`).
- **Never** put external service checks (DB, Redis) in liveness — only in readiness/health.
- Liveness always returns `pass` 200. Readiness/health return 503 on `fail`.
- Check names: `/^[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]*\z/` (`\z` anchor, trailing newline rejected) — throws `InvalidCheckNameException` otherwise.
- Checks are keyed by name: `add()`/constructor silently replace a check with the same name. `runByName()` with an unknown name returns `[]`, and `aggregateStatus([])` is `pass` — guard with `has()`.
- `/ready`/`/health` expose raw exception messages and topology — restrict access (internal port, ACL). No per-check timeout: set connect/read timeouts inside each check.
- Exception in `check()` is caught and converted to `HealthResult::fail`.
- Elapsed time > `warnThresholdMs` auto-upgrades `pass` → `warn`.
- Aggregation: any `fail` → `fail`; any `warn` (no fail) → `warn`; all `pass` → `pass`.
- Yii3 config-plugin ships `config/di.php` + `config/params.php` with `warnThresholdMs` and `livenessMessage`.
- Namespace: `Rasuvaeff\Yii3HealthCheck`.

## API

### HealthResult

```php
HealthResult::pass(name: 'db')
HealthResult::pass(name: 'db', message: 'Connected')
HealthResult::warn(name: 'db', message: 'Slow', data: ['latencyMs' => 950])
HealthResult::fail(name: 'db', message: 'Connection refused')

$r->name        // string
$r->status      // HealthStatus
$r->message     // string
$r->data        // array<string, mixed>
$r->elapsedMs   // float (set by HealthChecker, not by caller)

$r->withData(['rows' => 42])    // new instance
$r->withElapsedMs(12.5)         // new instance
$r->toArray()                   // omits elapsedMs:0 and data:[]
```

### HealthStatus

```php
HealthStatus::Pass  // 'pass' → HTTP 200
HealthStatus::Warn  // 'warn' → HTTP 200
HealthStatus::Fail  // 'fail' → HTTP 503
```

### HealthCheck (interface)

```php
interface HealthCheck {
    public function name(): string;
    public function check(): HealthResult;
}
```

### CallbackHealthCheck

```php
new CallbackHealthCheck(
    name: 'redis',
    check: static fn(): HealthResult => HealthResult::pass(name: 'redis'),
)
```

### HealthChecker

```php
$checker = new HealthChecker(
    checks: [$dbCheck, $redisCheck],
    clock: $psrClock,           // optional Psr\Clock\ClockInterface
    warnThresholdMs: 1000.0,    // default 1000ms
);

$checker->add($check);
$checker->has('database');                   // bool
$results = $checker->run();                  // array<string, HealthResult>
$results = $checker->runByName('database');  // array<string, HealthResult>

HealthChecker::aggregateStatus($results);    // HealthStatus
```

### Endpoints (PSR-15 RequestHandlerInterface)

```php
new LivenessEndpoint(responseFactory: $f, statusMessage: 'alive')
new ReadinessEndpoint(checker: $checker, responseFactory: $f)
new HealthEndpoint(checker: $checker, responseFactory: $f)
```

### Yii3 DI wiring

```php
// config/di.php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3HealthCheck\HealthChecker;
use Yiisoft\Definitions\Reference;

return [
    HealthChecker::class => [
        '__construct()' => [
            'checks' => [
                Reference::to(DatabaseHealthCheck::class),
                Reference::to(RedisHealthCheck::class),
            ],
            'warnThresholdMs' => $params['rasuvaeff/yii3-health-check']['warnThresholdMs'],
        ],
    ],
];
```

### Yii3 routes

```php
Route::get('/live')->action(LivenessEndpoint::class),
Route::get('/ready')->action(ReadinessEndpoint::class),
Route::get('/health')->action(HealthEndpoint::class),
```

### Custom check implementation

```php
final readonly class DatabaseHealthCheck implements HealthCheck
{
    public function __construct(private ConnectionInterface $db) {}

    public function name(): string { return 'database'; }

    public function check(): HealthResult
    {
        try {
            $this->db->createCommand('SELECT 1')->queryScalar();
            return HealthResult::pass(name: 'database');
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            return HealthResult::fail(name: 'database', message: $e->getMessage());
        }
    }
}
```

### Response format

```json
{
    "status": "pass",
    "checks": {
        "database": {"name":"database","status":"pass","message":"","elapsedMs":2.1},
        "redis":    {"name":"redis","status":"warn","message":"Check took 1243.0ms (threshold: 1000.0ms)","elapsedMs":1243.0}
    }
}
```

Liveness: `{"status":"pass","message":"alive"}`

### Kubernetes probes

```yaml
livenessProbe:
  httpGet: {path: /live, port: 8080}
  initialDelaySeconds: 5
  periodSeconds: 10

readinessProbe:
  httpGet: {path: /ready, port: 8080}
  initialDelaySeconds: 5
  periodSeconds: 10
```
